The ratio of the radius of uranium-238 to helium-4 is given by the cube root of the mass numbers: (238/4)^(1/3) ≈ 3.904. The minimum kinetic energy for antiproton production is 6 times the proton rest energy: 6 × 938.272 MeV = 5629.632 MeV. For a 7.0-TeV proton on a fixed target, the center-of-mass energy is √(2m_pE) ≈ 114.619 GeV. A gold ion with 100 GeV per nucleon has a speed β = √(1 − (m_p/E)^2) ≈ 0.999956. The time interval between the flashes, correcting for light travel time, is 4.96 μs + (1210 m − 480 m)/c ≈ 7.393 μs.
